profile.headline: SWE (TDP) @ AT&T | Prev SWE/Tech Intern @ HP, HomeCook and SEO | AI/ML Fellow @ Break Through Tech | MESA, SHPE, MLT, ColorStack & CodePath | CS @ UCSC
profile.summary:
Hello! I am a first generation Hispanic college student who completed his Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science at UC Santa Cruz. I'm a Software Engineer (Full-Time) for AT&T under the Technology Development Program. My particular interests are towards Full Stack Development, Backend Development/Software Engineering (Infrastructure/Distributed Systems) and Machine Learning. I have previously interned for HP Inc and HomeCook as a Software Engineer. In Summer 2025 - December 2025, I collaborated with International Elite Capital to promote and connect various fintech and news medias with international clients by developing analyzer and models through Break Through Tech AI.

Both on and off campus, I've honed my technical prowess, particularly focusing on Python. I completed the SEO Tech Developer internship program in Summer 2024, honing my full stack web development expertise in Python, CSS/HTML, JavaScript, MySQL and API Development. As a Full Stack Developer for the Tech4Good Research Lab, I've contributed to creating web applications for promoting educational learning resources and career pathway videos for undergrad/postgrad students.

I want to use my skills, knowledge and passion for promoting diversity and inclusion through the creation of technological solutions. 

Capable working across tech stack from low level (CLI & client/server design) to full stack applications. Additional experience in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems and machine learning

projects.title: Distributed Key Value Store
projects.description:
- Programming a distributed, casually consistent key-value store in Python (Flask) using gossip protocols, ensuring scalability and minimal data movement

- Systemizing network partitions with Docker for request forwarding and casual metadata tracking for robust consistency through Flask

projects.title: LayoffLens | Fullstack Web App
projects.description:
A full-stack web application designed and developed in a team of 4, that allows users to submit, browse, update, and delete layoff experiences, implementing a complete CRUD workflow and deploy via Render

- Architected RESTful API endpoints (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) to manage relational data, enabling real-time updates and consistent state across feed and company-specific view calls to a PostgreSQL database using Express

- Developed a multi-step submission form with validation, error handling and dynamic routing in React, improving data quality and user experience

- Implemented modal-based interactions and a filtering/sorting functionality, allowing users to explore and interact with data without page reloads

- Co-integrated an external API data ingestion to dynamically populate 20 layoff entries, implementing duplicate prevention and database synchronization logic

organizations.name: Break Through Tech
organizations.description: A virtual AI fellowship for preparing underrepresented undergraduate students in careers for Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and/or Data Science careers. This is achieved through a rigorous ML boot camp, followed by a tedious collaboration with an assigned company to work on real world challenges fellowship are prepared to work together and solve with one another. Additional professional development seminars and resources provided as well.
